root_causes.root_cause: _ARTICLE_RE regex in converters.py:226 requires 'Article \d+' (digits immediately after space) but UAE/English legal docs use parenthesized form 'Article (N)'. _segment_label returns [] for these headings, so _containment_depths returns None, and _relevel_by_containment leaves all Article headings at their original flat level. The _OVERSIZED_ORDINAL_RE in helpers.py:1798 correctly handles parens ('Art(?:icle|\.)?\s+\(?\s*') but this only fires in split_oversized_leaf_nodes for already-built nodes >50k chars - it cannot help when md_to_tree already produced many small flat nodes.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Widen _ARTICLE_RE to accept optional parentheses: r'^(?:Art(?:icle|\.)\s+\(?\s*\d+|§\s*\(?\s*\d+)'. This makes _segment_label extract the number from 'Article (47)' as label ['47'], enabling containment-based depth assignment.

root_causes.root_cause: German AHB documents use clause-level numbering (e.g. 'Ziffer 1', numbered paragraphs) that Docling does not detect as section headers - they stay as plain prose text. Unlike Arabic structural markers which have _inject_arabic_structural_headings to promote plain-text markers to headings, there is no equivalent injection for German clause patterns ('Ziffer N', 'Ziff. N') or for English 'Article (N)' patterns when Docling misses them entirely. The heading-depth recovery chain (_relevel_by_containment/_relevel_by_numbering/_relevel_by_outline) can only re-level EXISTING headings, not create new ones from prose.
root_causes.code_path: src/pageindex_mcp/converters.py:98 (_inject_arabic_structural_headings) -> converters.py:2759 (call site in pdf_to_markdown_docling) - missing analogous function for German/English legal patterns
root_causes.suggested_fix: Add _inject_german_clause_headings (for 'Ziffer N' / 'Ziff. N' patterns) and _inject_english_article_headings (for 'Article (N)' at line start) analogous to _inject_arabic_structural_headings. Call them alongside the Arabic injection at converters.py:2759-2760.

root_causes.root_cause: _segment_table_nodes is called ONLY on garble-recovery paths (client.py:1126, 1312) but NOT on the primary tree-build path (client.py:1031). GHV-TKV-Tarif is a pricing table document that traverses the primary path without garble issues, so _segment_table_nodes never fires, leaving the multi-column table as a single flat leaf. RFC-030 explicitly identified and DEFERRED this fix.
root_causes.code_path: src/pageindex_mcp/client.py:1031 (primary path - split_oversized_leaf_nodes called without _segment_table_nodes) vs client.py:1126 (garble path - both called)
root_causes.suggested_fix: Add result['structure'] = _segment_table_nodes(result.get('structure', [])) after line 1031 in client.py (and line 1428 in the image-escalation path). Resolve validate_tree ordering: run _segment_table_nodes BEFORE validate_tree so the segmented structure is what gets validated.
